question: How much greater is this practice than gifts such as the horse-sacrifice?
premises: Gifts such as the horse-sacrifice are taken as a standard of merit.
The comparison uses crores multiplied by crores.
The result is described as greater in quality or measure.
inference: This practice surpasses gifts like the horse-sacrifice by crores upon crores of times.
plain_english: It is greater by crores and crores of times than gifts such as the horse-sacrifice and others.
